title: Binary matroid representation of cyclic families
statement: Let B be a k-element subset of the cyclic group Z_n. Then there is a rank-k binary matroid on Z_n in which every cyclic translate B+i is a basis.

counterexample.description: A four-element subset B of Z_n, outside the known cyclic-interval case, for which exhaustive enumeration of normalized binary matrices finds no representation making every cyclic translate of B a basis.
